name: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 v1.1
soc: ESP32-S3 (Xtensa dual-core 32-bit LX7 @ up to 240 MHz, vector instructions, 512 KB SRAM)
wireless: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi (802.11 b/g/n) with HT40 & CSI capture, Bluetooth 5 (LE)

revision_differences.v1_1_vs_v1_0: On v1.1, the addressable RGB LED is routed to GPIO38. On older v1.0, it was routed to GPIO48. GPIO48 is an ordinary external header pin on v1.1.
revision_differences.memory_restrictions: For Octal flash and Octal PSRAM module variants (e.g. WROOM-1-N8R8), GPIO35, GPIO36, and GPIO37 are consumed internally by SPIDQS, SPIIO7, SPIIO6 and must NOT be used externally.

components.name: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 Module
components.function: Dual-core 240MHz MCU, 8MB Flash, 512KB SRAM, 2.4GHz Wi-Fi receiver for CSI packets
components.physical_location: Top center of PCB under nickel-plated RF shield
components.role_in_prw_wild: Runs high-speed CSI frame extraction, baseline noise filtering, and edge corroboration engine

components.name: 2.4 GHz Inverted-F PCB Antenna
components.physical_location: Top edge of module, unshielded PCB keepout zone
components.role_in_prw_wild: Receives 802.11 OFDM packets from WIFI_AP_01 for multi-subcarrier CSI amplitude and phase matrix analysis

components.name: USB-to-UART Port (Micro-USB / USB-C)
components.function: Serial flashing, logging, and 5V power supply via CP2102N / CH343 bridge
components.role_in_prw_wild: Diagnostics, serial telemetry streaming, and base-station firmware maintenance

components.name: ESP32-S3 USB OTG Port
components.function: Direct native USB OTG full-speed connection (GPIO19 D-, GPIO20 D+)
components.role_in_prw_wild: High-throughput CSI raw packet streaming to central gateway

components.name: BOOT Button (Download Mode)
components.function: Pull down GPIO0 to enter UART download bootloader mode

components.name: RST / EN Button (Reset)
components.physical_location: Bottom left, near USB OTG port

components.name: Addressable RGB LED (WS2812 / SK6812)
components.function: Addressable 24-bit RGB status indicator (explicitly GPIO38 on v1.1)
components.physical_location: Center board between regulator and module
components.role_in_prw_wild: Visual operational state: Green = Standby, Amber = Corroborating, Red = Risk Gated / Alarm

components.name: 3.3V Power Indicator LED
components.function: Illuminates red/green when 3.3V regulator rail is energized

components.name: 3.3V LDO Voltage Regulator
components.function: Steps down 5V USB/VBUS power to stable 3.3V @ 500mA-1000mA rail
components.role_in_prw_wild: Regulated clean power supply for ESP32-S3, vibration module, and INMP441 microphone

components.name: Pin Header J1 (Left, 22 pins)
components.function: 3.3V power, Reset, Touch, ADC, I2S, 5V power output, and GND breakout
components.physical_location: Left rail of PCB (22 pins, 2.54mm pitch)
components.role_in_prw_wild: Interconnect for PIR VCC (5V, Pin 21), PIR Output (GPIO4, Pin 4), Vibration (GPIO5, Pin 5), and I2S Mic (GPIO7, 8, 9 at Pins 7, 12, 15)

components.name: Pin Header J3 (Right, 22 pins)
components.function: GND, UART, JTAG, high-numbered GPIO breakout, and Native USB
components.physical_location: Right rail of PCB (22 pins, 2.54mm pitch)
components.role_in_prw_wild: Provides common system GND (Pins 1, 21, 22), native USB pins (GPIO19 Pin 20, GPIO20 Pin 19), and GPIO48/47 (Pins 16/17)

proposed_sensor_wiring.engineering_notes: HC-SR501 has an onboard 7133-1 LDO regulator requiring minimum 4.5V input. Connected to verified Header J1 Pin 21 (5V rail). Do NOT use 3.3V rail.
Common ground reference connected to verified Header J3 Pin 22 (or J1 Pin 22).
HC-SR501 output is 3.3V TTL logic level (via internal 7133 regulator), safe for ESP32-S3 3.3V GPIO. Configured with GPIO pull-down.
SW-420 LM393 comparator operates from 3.3V to 5V. Powered from ESP32 3.3V rail for matched logic levels.
LM393 open-collector comparator with 10k pull-up to VCC (3.3V). Pulses high on physical ground seismic vibration.
